nodes.label: Analysing Argument: Persuasive Techniques (VCE Reference Table)
nodes.rationale: Naming a technique earns no marks on its own; strong VCE analysis explains how a technique positions the intended audience to think or feel, and why the writer placed it where they did. The table therefore pairs each technique with its intended effect on the reader, not just a definition.
